{{Top|leg}}
'''Ladybabies''' were a food, often covered in [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]]. [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] once served chocolate-covered ladybabies to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He also occasionally used his chocolate ladybabies along with [[Beignet]]s as bribes to the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards to take food to Jabba’s prisoners such as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
